cat > /root/menu-live-patch.sh <<'MLPEOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Live-patch /usr/local/bin/menu (dividers + ports split + statsonline counter).
set -e
TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
[ -f /usr/local/bin/menu ] && cp /usr/local/bin/menu /usr/local/bin/menu.bak-$TS && echo "[*] Backup: /usr/local/bin/menu.bak-$TS"
echo '' | base64 -d | gzip -d > /usr/local/bin/menu.new
if bash -n /usr/local/bin/menu.new 2>/dev/null; then
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/menu.new && mv /usr/local/bin/menu.new /usr/local/bin/menu
    echo "[ OK ] menu patched. Exit to shell (press 0) then type: menu"
else
    echo "[!] Syntax check failed - NOT applied. Old menu untouched."; rm -f /usr/local/bin/menu.new; exit 1
fi
MLPEOF
bash /root/menu-live-patch.sh
